description: This source file defines the PHP class 'BedrockClient' within the AWS SDK for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to Amazon Bedrock, indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods, and extends the base 'AwsClient' class.

classes.name: BedrockClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Bedrock service via AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods for managing evaluation jobs, models, guardrails, and other resources related to Amazon Bedrock.
